title: Melia Winata - Weaving a Better Generation | BukaTalks
description: Du'anyam is a social entrepreneur or social entrepreneurship that produces and distributes woven crafts to empower women, improve the health of mothers and children, and for cultural promotion.  The background of the establishment of the du'anyam is a social issue of maternal and child health problems in remote areas in Indonesia. These problems such as small income and there is no wider job opportunity except in the fields. Ironically, pregnant women there also experience malnutrition.  Du'anyam comes with a solution by inviting them to hone skills in weaving, and educating the commercial values ​​of this woven.  Melia Winata, a du'anyam co-founder gives us inspiration that being an entrepreneur does not only have to think of profit, but can also improve the standard of living of the environment around us. Come on, watch the bukatalks right now!   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Bukatalks: Bukatalks is an initiative from Bukalapak to build a forum for creators and innovators to share inspirational stories for young people, in the format of discussions held routinely every month.   Bukatalks themes are made varied, ranging from technology to art, by presenting topics and speakers who can open the eyes of the audience and provide a new perspective. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Subscribe: http://bl.id/subs-bukalapak  Bukatalks Video Empower Through Entrepreneurship: https://www.youtube.com/playlist  Other #bukatalks videos: https://www.youtube.com/watch  Website: https://www.bukalapak.com/  Download the Bukalapak application here iOS: https://itunes.apple.com/id/app/bukalapak-jual-beli-online/id1003169137?l=id  Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bukalapak.android   Like / follow social media bukalapak: Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/bukalapak Twitter - https://www.twitter.com/bukalapak Instagram - https://instagram.com/bukalapak Google Plus - https://plus.google.com/+bukalapakdotcom Community Forum - https://komunitas.bukalapak.com Stack Overflow - https://stackoverflow.com/jobs/companies/bukalapak LinkedIn-https://www.linkedin.com/company/pt-bukalapak-com

asr.full_text: I hope it will be still exciting, Ok? Introduce my name, I'm Melia I'm one of the co-founder of Duanyam and I'm here as the Chief Marketing officer of DoAnyam. The city called Maumere is Mawmere people in Sika province. If you call your mother, it is called dua. Like dua Suci and dua Amelia. Dua Nyam literally means Mother to pray. Dua Nyam is a social enterprise. Which is about the distribution of a woman's spiritual talent mom and kids health, as well can promote culture. As what you see in this video, the background is problem of mom and kids health in worst in Indonesia. The very first event happened in 2013 as I was visiting Flores with my 2 partners. And we witnessed health issues there. So, Duanyam is based on Social, health issues. Then we thought about what can give provide solutions for those health problems. As I told in another video at that time, the health problems in Flores, the first area that we worked, the death rate among parents and children is very high. One out of three children lost his or her mother, 260 260 babies, 40 mothers in death almost daily. This being was one of the chronic health issue in Indonesia, especially in NTT province. Seeing the extremely important health problem in important space, we try to find out, what causes health problems among mothers and children as high as it could be? First, we believe that mothers living in NTT have less access to capital. The sun's rays we see are from garden or agriculture, where we know that agriculture income is unstable all the year. The seasons when we plant or harvest not yet. So we depend on the weather situation. Parents income is 225.000 per month. Only from that income they can get benefit. We saw that there is no opportunities of work other than in fields. In a place of imbalance of the amount of nutrition received by women to the hard work in fields. For the women especially, when they are pregnant or early. They should still work in farming and manage their farms. Question is where are the husbands? These husbands are likely in NTT areas and they keep track of their jobs so they don't stay in Flora but work overseas. Many of them go to Bali, Java, or abroad. Therefore, the mothers have to take care of the family, farm, and their children. Finally, because of these opportunities, the mother has to go to farm. almost half of the pregnant women is suffering from lack of nutrition, or also called lack of energy and calories. Then we looked for solution for these women to them so that their problem could solved. First, we'll see that they have expertise. That is, they're capable in dealing with skills that have been passed down to other generations. Usually if they are from Javanese or Bali, we usually just cover, they usually use it for traditional ceremony. In Flores, same to Bali, it will be familiar to you. Many rituals and ceremonies that are performed by people. So, the ladies, because they're talented, they didn't see that the products are commercial value. They could make them, their neighbors and almost every woman who was there could make it. But they didn't realize that quality is important, because they will take the one that is damaged and sell later. That is how it is. The skills on making anyaman were not commercially available at the time in Flores. Second, we see the raw materials rather than the pulp from mother plant in the florence, which is pulp from dandruff. The raw materials, the trees grow wild in the florence so they grow fast in dry and dull areas. So there are really many raw materials in it. And these deworms takes alpaca leaves sustainably to avoid to kill or kill these trees. So, for example we follow the cycle. Every month one time one apple per month will grow. than when leaves were growing. What we did was take the trees we had. For instance, this month we take them from Tree A, the next month, we stopped taking them. We let the buds grow up and remain alive. The third is, we see opportunities in which industry practice in developing in India and foreign countries. An opportunity where craft business has been growing In domestic as well as in domestic We the three tries to answer the ladies The first way, we connect the skills that they did to the market The second is we empower women through financial security. One of the problems was that women don't become buyers, or give them money for free. So, the risk from the market and sales, is not on the ladies' level, but on the menses' level. So, we give orders, we provide market access end-to-end. This team is end-to-end, from community to the market. Third, because we have working directly works company, we became a partner. We set up platform for other organisations to help, to impact, the society's social effects. The approach was the first, we taught the market conditions, we train them to carry out what they want. The challenge at the beginning is balancing supply and demand. Because in 2013 we started that mother can make product A, the want product B. But, nothing was found. Then, we try to, ok where is the design that makes sense for mothers? Because all the work or product that were produced is a challenge. Its a handmade product. Secondly, we provide upfront cash. That's what I explained how we give cash to the products that already produced by mothers and has our standard quality The new women who are training to do nipping are will enter grade C. So, the way to train them so that the quality becomes better and they can get a higher income from the grading. Third is providing market access to their products. This can be exhibition, and so in. For this update, we have paid off 500 mothers to have 22 villages in East Flores. We increased their earnings 40% for our kid's study expenses, daily living needs and savings. These are our products. Dua Nyam has 2 categories of baskets, slippers, tray, and the other stuff inside, we got bags, wallet, ID tex, and other stuff. We collaborate with a designer, the Indonesian designer. for Indonesian brands to bring traditional craft into modern lifestyle. One of it is the one you have here, we launched our retail collection for the first time here in Jakarta Fashion Week 2017. We had shared the collaboration of Cotton Ink. Last year we became the award winner of I will be one of the winners in natural fiber category for this exhibition. It divided by corporate gifts, souvenirs when they have event or show. In retail, we can also get our products in department store or shoppings mall in Jakarta. In total we have partners with more than 50 wholesale client so far, the average product that we distribute per month is around 3000 items a month. We're also proud of this year, we just finished last year, Two Yum becomes officials Merch souvenirs from Asian Games 2018. Combining materials and materials from the flowerpots. So you can see at the pictures, Bin Bin and Atung. They were what I have described in beginning. We are a platform for other organizations to deliver social impact... So that Dudu Annam was only focused on 3 pillars to empower women, improving the child and mother and child and promoting culture. For example, when we work with KALEBE, KALEBE produces milk for pregnant women. Therefore, for Duanyam offered its open trip. We gather those interested not only travelling or visiting tourist attractions but also visiting the community enterprise. It's a unique traveling trip. Not only just travelling but we also visited the first ladies of our florists. The first to come the In Florence, there were 35 employees who were in the Du'a Nyam. These people really made us empower female in Indonesia. We were lucky that we got large media coverage from TV media to print media. There are also government support that helped us, The initiative is to showcase our products. Then recently with Back Craft, we have participated in Raw Identities exhibition. In Del Mobile Salone in Milan, Italy. Du'anyam started up in West Floria in 2014, and has been expanding to several further regions in Indonesia. One of which is Papua and Berau. Papua is in the town of Nab Berau, a coastal city in East Kalimantan. Our vision from both of them is to be the Go-To Brand in the year of 2020 for Indonesian traditional cloth products. A brand that possess unique, ethical and high quality design. Where we can use our vision to celebrate 2000 mothers, increase their income by at least 30% And while we'll expand in other regions, we'll keep holding three pillars I mentioned earlier Okay, this is my last slide. Maybe there is something that I want to say. If you want to start up or in your early stage in doing business. I will say that be an entrepreneur is not easy, especially being a social entrepreneur is really two times more difficult or the challenge is doubled. When you run an enterprise you need patience. Sometimes we want to work today so we have tomorrow so we can have success. But to reach success, I'm sure there are a lot of fails that happened in the beginning. And we have to calm, and also persistence. When we become failure, how how can we lift up ourselves again and move forward. Thank you.
